subject: GreenStream: request for credit memo & ledger mapping for promotional stipend
messages:
From: Elena Rios <elena@greenstream.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@greenstream.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promotional stipend credit memo to offset June invoice

Hi Michael / Naomi,

Thanks again for the speedy onboarding last month — the campaign launch went well. Per our agreement, GreenStream is due a promotional stipend that should be applied as a credit against Invoice #0428 (issued 2028-06-05). Can you help with a credit memo and confirm how this will be posted on your side?

Quick details:
- Invoice: #0428 for $32,400
- Promotional stipend amount: $7,500 (one-time pilot allowance)
- Desired treatment: offset the invoice balance and show a credit memo to our AP team for reconciliation

I attached the invoice and a brief note of the promo terms. Our AP contact is finance_ops@greenstream.com — they’ll need the credit memo and a short explanation of the ledger mapping (GLA references) for their records.

Appreciate your help — can you confirm timeline?

Best,
Elena
Elena Rios
Head of Partnerships, GreenStream Media
[Attachment: GreenStream_Invoice_0428.pdf (PDF)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rios <elena@greenstream.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: promotional stipend credit memo to offset June invoice

Thanks Elena — looping in Finance (Naomi) and Accounting Ops (Marcus) + CS billing (Monica) to handle the credit memo and GL mapping.

Naomi / Marcus / Monica — GreenStream is requesting a $7,500 credit to offset Invoice #0428. They need:
- A formal credit memo PDF we can send to finance_ops@greenstream.com
- The ledger/GL account used for the credit (they often need the GLA code to ingest into their ERP)
- Confirmation whether this posts as contra-revenue or an allowance (so their auditors understand the treatment)

Can we target end-of-day tomorrow for a draft credit memo? I’ve attached the promo terms Elena included.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promo_terms_2028.docx (DOCX)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 15:32:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Request: promotional stipend credit memo to offset June invoice

Thanks Michael. Tagging internal notes and proposed mapping below — happy to revise if Marcus wants a different approach.

Proposed accounting treatment:
- Credit memo amount: $7,500
- Posting: Use GLA 6010-PRM (Promotional Allowances) — this posts to contra-revenue/marketing allowance bucket.
- Reason code: CM-PROMO-2028

If Marcus prefers contra-revenue to be split across ARR vs one-time, flag now; otherwise we'll go with single-line allowance.

I will draft the credit memo (PDF) and share a DocuSign-ready copy by EOD tomorrow. Attaching the draft for internal review.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
[Attachment: credit_memo_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: promotional stipend credit memo to offset June invoice

Naomi — thanks for the headstart. A couple of quick accounting clarifications from my side:

- Recommend posting as contra-revenue under GLA 7012-ContraRevenue rather than marketing expense so the customer-facing AR balances match gross revenue lines during audits.
- If the client needs the credit to net to zero on their AP file immediately, we can apply $7,500 against #0428 and issue a single-line credit memo.
- If there is any plan to spread the promotion across future billing periods (unlikely here), we should use an allowance spread schedule.

Also: please include original invoice number and invoice date on the credit memo (GreenStream prefers that format). Once Naomi finalizes the PDF, I’ll approve for issuance.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager
[Note: no attachment]
